# ToolkitGen

> Free, high-performance browser-based tools, calculators, and hardware diagnostics. Every tool executes client-side in browser memory with no server uploads.

## Documentation & AI Manifests
- [Machine-Readable Tools Registry](https://toolkitgen.com/tools.json): JSON catalog of all tools, capabilities, parameters, and input/output contracts.
- [Full Documentation Manifest](https://toolkitgen.com/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive technical descriptions, feature specifications, and procedures.
- [XML Sitemap Index](https://toolkitgen.com/sitemap-index.xml): Authoritative index of all static tool and guide endpoints.

## Developer / Data
- [Crontab Generator & Visualizer](https://toolkitgen.com/tool/cron_job_visualizer): The Logic of Cron: Mastering the Pulse of Unix Automation In the intricate infrastructure of Unix-based systems, Cron is the heartbeat of the machine.
- [cURL to Fetch, Axios, Node & Python Converter](https://toolkitgen.com/tool/curl_to_fetch_axios): Convert cURL commands to modern JavaScript Fetch API, Axios, Node.js, and Python Requests. Parses methods, headers, and payloads with local browser parsing.
- [DuckDB-WASM Parquet & CSV SQL Explorer](https://toolkitgen.com/tool/duckdb_wasm_analytics): Query local Parquet and CSV files using client-side SQL in browser memory. Fast columnar analytics, zero data uploads, and exportable result sets.
- [HAR File Sanitizer and Filter](https://toolkitgen.com/tool/har_sanitizer_viewer): Sanitize HTTP Archive HAR files by removing cookies, authorization tokens, and API keys locally in your browser before sharing support bundles.
- [Local LLM VRAM Calculator](https://toolkitgen.com/tool/llm_vram_calculator): Calculate exact VRAM memory requirements for running local LLMs: analyze model weights, quantization formats (Q4_K_M, Q8, FP16), and KV cache context length.
- [Online LaTeX Equation Editor](https://toolkitgen.com/tool/latex_equation_editor): Typesetting: Why LaTeX Defines Modern Science In the high-stakes world of academic publishing and scientific research, clarity is the primary currency.
- [Probability Distribution Calculator](https://toolkitgen.com/tool/statistical_dist_plot): Uncertainty: A Masterclass in Probability Modeling Randomness is not chaos; it is a clinical structure governed by deterministic mathematical laws.
- [Regex Visualizer & Debugger](https://toolkitgen.com/tool/regex_flowchart_gen): The Architecture of Patterns: A Masterclass in Regular Expression Logic Regular Expressions, or Regex , are the mathematical language of pattern recognition.
- [Screenshot Secret Redactor & Scanner](https://toolkitgen.com/tool/screenshot_secret_scanner): Detect and redact API keys, tokens, credentials, and sensitive private data in pasted screenshots using client-side canvas masks.
- [Search Query Formatter](https://toolkitgen.com/tool/advanced_search_operator_builder): Mastering search engine indexing algorithms, deterministic boolean query filters, Google Hacking Database (GHDB) dorking, and OSINT investigative techniques.
- [SQLite WASM Explorer & In-Browser SQL Sandbox](https://toolkitgen.com/tool/sqlite_wasm_explorer): Inspect SQLite .db databases, run custom queries, and export results to CSV/JSON in your browser. Powered by WebAssembly with local file processing.
